name: AddPay WooCommerce
author: addpay

sections.description:
AddPay WooCommerce integrates AddPay’s secure payment processing into your WooCommerce store. Accept payments via credit cards, mobile payments (e.g., ScanToPay), and more through a hosted checkout page. Key features include:

  • Secure payment initiation with RSA-SHA256 signature generation
  • Support for multiple payment methods
  • Seamless transaction status updates
  • Easy setup with Private Key, Application ID, Merchant ID, and Store ID

Perfect for merchants looking to streamline their payment process with a reliable and secure solution.

Plugin Installation

Getting Started with AddPay

Follow these quick steps to integrate AddPay with your WooCommerce store:

  • Register Your Account
    Visit: https://onboarding.addpay.cloud/merchant/onboarding
    Complete the sign-up process.
  • Request Plugin Credentials
    After registering, contact support@addpay.africa to request the credentials required to activate the WooCommerce plugin.

Installation Steps

  • In WordPress Admin, go to Plugins > Add New and search for “AddPay”.
  • Click “Install Now” and activate the plugin.
  • Navigate to plugin settings and enter your Private Key, Application ID, Merchant ID, and Store ID. Save your changes.
  • Test the checkout process using a product and choose AddPay as the payment method.

Developer Info

The AddPay Payment Gateway plugin is built for WooCommerce and integrates AddPay’s payment processing service. Developers can contribute or extend the plugin by following these steps.

Prerequisites

  • NPM: For managing JavaScript dependencies. Install NPM
  • Composer: For managing PHP dependencies. Install Composer
  • wp-env: For running a local WordPress environment. Learn about wp-env
  • PHP: Version 7.4 or higher.

Setup

  1. Clone the repository: AddPay WooCommerce.
  2. Install dependencies:
    composer install
    npm install
  3. Build the plugin:
    npm run build
  4. Start a local WordPress environment:
    wp-env start

For more details, visit the GitHub repository.
